limitations.description: The primary manual is a 2004 historical reference and not a controlled current code edition.
Temperature screening alone does not establish corrosion, hydrogen, sour, chloride, caustic, amine, ammonia, welding or toughness suitability.
No allowable stress values are supplied; the design module requires controlled user or organization data.
External pressure, nozzle reinforcement, local loads, fatigue, MDMT and supports are excluded.
A static GitHub Pages app is not a controlled enterprise approval or records system.
At least one material guide entry is ambiguous and must remain blocked until verified.
